parameters.content:
## TikTok trending hashtags, sounds and creators to Google Sheets (Apify)

1. Add your **Apify** credential (Apify API token) to the Apify node.
2. Add a **Google Sheets** credential and pick your spreadsheet in the last node.
3. Edit the input JSON in the Apify node.
4. Click Execute workflow. The Actor is pay per event: [https://apify.com/johnveds15/tiktok-trending-scraper](https://apify.com/johnveds15/tiktok-trending-scraper). The Apify node's *Maximum Cost per Run* is set so one run cannot exceed it.
